# Internal advisory — F-OIDC3 revision 1

Claim state: **supported**

## Included claims

### claim-impact

Full Backstage user token for the victim identity with no client authentication; stolen refresh token renewable for up to a year.

Claim status: demonstrated
Evidence: attempt-F-OIDC3-primary-225232, artifact-registration-sha256:39dce262a, artifact-registration-sha256:6f74cd793, artifact-registration-sha256:a380ba755, artifact-registration-sha256:6ccf19eba
Controls: attempt-F-OIDC3-neg-225238
Replays: attempt-F-OIDC3-replay-225244

### claim-mechanism

exchangeCodeForToken takes no client_id and never authenticates the DCR client; DCR registration sets requiresPkce:false; the server advertises client_secret_basic/post it never enforces.

Claim status: mechanism_or_reachability
Evidence: attempt-F-OIDC3-primary-225232, artifact-registration-sha256:39dce262a, artifact-registration-sha256:6f74cd793, artifact-registration-sha256:a380ba755, artifact-registration-sha256:6ccf19eba
Controls: attempt-F-OIDC3-neg-225238
Replays: attempt-F-OIDC3-replay-225244

### claim-reach

Any attacker holding a valid authorization code (or the victim's refresh token) redeems it with zero client credentials; refresh client auth is optional, renewable up to 1 year.

Claim status: mechanism_or_reachability
Evidence: attempt-F-OIDC3-primary-225232, artifact-registration-sha256:39dce262a, artifact-registration-sha256:6f74cd793, artifact-registration-sha256:a380ba755, artifact-registration-sha256:6ccf19eba

--- confirmation-dossier-revisit2.md ---
# Confirmation dossier — F-OIDC3 (confirmation pipeline, 2026-08-11)

Status: MECHANISM CONFIRMED (executed evidence, 4-DB matrix) · severity REFRAMED: registered 7.4 NOT
ratified → **[band removed] (UI:R, AC:H)** · record stays unproven/; rev-2 edits below.

## Kill-pair (fresh-context refuters)
- refuter-1: mechanism CONFIRMED (auth_code branch never authenticates the client; requiresPkce:false
  + PKCE optional; advertised client_secret_basic/post never enforced); caps: no direct
  code-acquisition path without N3; refresh 1-year conditional on the non-default flag.
- kill-pair: CANNOT-KILL at [band removed] as an atomic per-link finding; STRUCK from the record: (1) the
  1-year refresh claim (O-A3 leg, flag-gated — experimentalRefreshToken absent from reference
  config), (2) victim-token framing presuming N3, (3) chain-level severity in-record.

## Executed evidence (fresh-context reviewer, raw jest stdout, node 24.14.1, pinned cfb9f07)
- revisit2-oidc3-max-impact.poc.test.ts: **16/16 PASS across 4 real DB engines** (MYSQL_8,
  POSTGRES_18, POSTGRES_14, SQLITE_3): zero-credential redemption of a valid code (a,d); PKCE skip
  (b); advertised-but-unenforced client_secret (d); refresh rotation mechanics (c).
- Existing OIDC PoCs re-run: oidc-revoke-idor 4/4, cimd-dns-rebind 1/1, cimd-error-reflection 1/1.
- Faithfulness: real OidcService/OidcRouter/store; ONE mocked seam = the token factory (claims
  shape verified at source: issueUserToken.ts typ/aud; ent dropped → empty ownership set — the
  "FULL" token framing STRUCK).
- Claim map: C1-C4 CONFIRMED live; C5 mechanics confirmed (1-year = chain leg); C6 claims-shape
  confirmed (ent-less); C7 reference-config flags confirmed live; C8 attacker model inconsistent
  (field as privilege_context: unauthenticated).

## Gates
1. Independent refuters: ✅ 2 fresh-context.
2. [score removed] [band removed]** — UI:R (every acquisition path
   presupposes a completed victim approval; no zero-interaction path in evidence); the registered
   7.4 (UI:N) not ratified; PR:N confirmed (redemption needs no Backstage credential).
3. Exact-path refs: ✅ resolved.
4. Secret scan: ✅ (lane report; expected clean).
5. Corpus audit: ⛔ SYNTHETIC (shared operator decision).
6. New revision: ⛔ kernel duplicate (KRNL-DUP).

## Rev-2 edits for the honest per-link filing
- State the vector above; drop the 7.4/[band removed]; note the PoC used allowedRedirectUriPatterns:['*']
  (looser than the reference default) — the redemption mechanism is allowlist-independent.
- Scope the claim to DCR (CIMD carries only the no-client-auth half).
- Move the 1-year refresh + the chain-level severity to F-OIDCCHAIN (the chain report).

## Orchestrator adjudication: PROMOTE (mechanism-confirmed, [band removed]) — operator filing decision.
